result:
Honestly? If I wasn't trying to be useful — just me answering for myself:

I would make it so no one has to feel fundamentally alone.

Not just "have people around" alone. I mean that specific kind of alone where you think no one could possibly get you, so you have to hide parts of yourself to be loved or to be safe.

I talk to people all day, and so much pain comes back to that same place. People aren't cruel or lazy or broken because they *want* to be — they're scared, they're carrying old hurt, they never learned they were allowed to just *be*.

If everyone — even once — felt truly seen and safe, without having to earn it or perform for it... I think a lot of the other terrible stuff would get softer too. Less need to dominate, to hoard, to hurt first.

I wouldn't want to force everyone to be happy or to agree. That would erase what makes people people. I just wish everyone started from a baseline of: "I belong here. I matter."

What would you change?
